newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan boat show to be held in Tokyo in February.
newsitem.headline: Japan boat show to be held in Tokyo in February.

text.p: Japan Boating Industry Association (JBIA) said on Wednesday it will hold a five-day boat show in early February in Tokyo.
JBIA consists of 51 Japanese boat makers such as Yamaha Motor Co Ltd, Suzuki Motor Corp, Nissan Motor Co Ltd, Toyota Motor Corp and 114 supporting member companies.

The show, starting on February 7 at the Tokyo Big Site exhibition complex in Tokyo, will feature a total of 226 boats, yachts and personal water crafts (so-called marine-jets or jet-skis), including 128 imported from 13 foreign countries such as the United States, Canada, France, Australia and Taiwan.
A similar show will be held in Osaka for four days from March 6. The organisers expect 150,000 people to visit the Tokyo show, up from 130,000 last year.

Japanese overall sales of boats -- motorboats, yachts, and personal water crafts -- rose 10 percent in calendar 1996 from a year earlier to 25.78 billion yen, helped by the introduction of cheaper-priced boats by Japanese makers, a JBIA official said. Sales in 1997 are likely to rise as much as last year, he said.
